surfaces.name: Sculptor desktop app (Electron; macOS Apple Silicon, Linux x64 and arm64)
sculpt CLI (Sculptor API client, also used by agents)
Local Sculptor backend API (default port 5050) and optional custom backend command

claims.answer: Electron desktop app for macOS (Apple Silicon only) and Linux (x64 and arm64) with a local backend; the `sculpt` CLI for agents and scripts; no Windows, Intel Mac or editor-extension client. The user docs and SECURITY.md describe local use only, but the repository also ships a web build (installable PWA) that the backend serves in an OpenHost self-hosted deployment; the two first-party sources are not reconciled.

desktop_os.answer: README downloads: macOS Apple Silicon, Linux and Linux ARM64; the 0.50.0 release lists a macOS dmg and Linux x64/arm64 AppImages; no Windows or Intel macOS build.

mobile_apps.answer: No mobile app; the README download list is complete for desktop builds only.

browser.answer: No browser client in the README downloads or help pages, and SECURITY.md says it is for local use and not network exposure; the repository nevertheless ships a web build and an OpenHost deployment (openhost.toml, openhost.Dockerfile) in which the backend serves the bundled web UI behind OpenHost's owner login.

mobile_browser.answer: Not in the user docs; the repository has a responsive mobile UI spec and mocks, a PWA manifest and a phone live-preview front for the OpenHost deployment, so a phone browser is an intended but undocumented client.

cli.answer: `sculpt` CLI (workspace, agent, repo, extension, signal, ui, debug commands) against the local backend.

editor_extensions.answer: No editor extension; Sculptor can open workspaces in an editor and has its own UI extensions.

task_actions.answer: Start agents, steer in chat, answer pending questions, review changes, commit, create PRs and resume.

notifications.answer: Substituted question/plan tools raise notifications "more likely to reach you"; notification channels and settings are not documented in the help pages read.

cross_device_continuity.answer: Desktop state is local to the machine (~/.sculptor) with no sync; in the OpenHost deployment the database and workspaces live in a persistent app-data directory on the host, which any browser session can reach.

evidence.title: OpenHost self-hosted deployment of Sculptor
evidence.locator: header comment lines 1-20, [runtime.container] and [resources] (memory_mb 4096, cpu_cores 4.0), [data] app_data; openhost.Dockerfile header lines 1-10
evidence.finding: The repository ships an OpenHost app manifest and Dockerfile that build the backend and the web UI from source and run the backend, serving the bundled UI itself with no Electron shell, in a rootless podman container reverse-proxied over HTTPS behind OpenHost's owner login; Claude Code agents run as subprocesses inside the container and the database, workspaces and Claude/gh auth persist in the app data directory.

evidence.title: Web build with PWA manifest
evidence.locator: header comment lines 1-8 and the VitePWA block lines 37-75
evidence.finding: A separate web build of the frontend, served by the backend it talks to (same-origin API), carries a PWA manifest so the web UI is installable on a home screen; the Electron renderer build never registers the service worker.

evidence.title: Mobile web UI and phone live preview
evidence.finding: The preview script serves a dev preview reachable from a phone through the OpenHost nginx proxy behind the owner session, and agent_docs/responsive-mobile-ui holds a spec, plan and mocks for a responsive mobile UI; none of this appears in docs/help.

locations.result: sculptor-v0.50.0 (2026-11-16) is the latest release after 0.50.0rc2 (2026-11-13) and 0.49.0 (2026-10-21); release bodies link installers on S3 and describe builds, not future plans.
States the app is an experimental research preview that may change drastically and that external contributions are limited; no roadmap or dates.
Phase 1 frontend-only PostHog now; backend telemetry re-enable "planned (SCU-764)" with no date; not treated as an announcement.
Launch post (published 2025-09-26, last updated 2026-04-30) describes an earlier container-based version and promises Suggestions (beta); shown for history, not current capability.
Public tracker for bugs and ideas; no dated product announcements read.

announced.summary: posthog.md: backend telemetry re-enable is planned (SCU-764) after the frontend-only phase; undated.
